study: Cumulative operation timers from the existing Mini-SGLang host-DRAM study
scope: Selected fields from four archived result JSON files; no experiment, replay, or model run. These are operation-timer measurements, separate from the rounded mean-session results.

accounting.d2h_ms: Sum of CUDA-event durations for GPU-to-host saves across the measured run. Events include GPU staging/gather and host copy operations.
accounting.h2d_ms: Sum of CUDA-event durations for on-demand host-to-GPU restores across the measured run. Events include host copy and GPU staging/scatter operations.
accounting.prefetch_h2d_ms: Sum of CUDA-event durations for prefetched restores; zero in these FCFS/LRU runs with prefetch disabled.
accounting.total_transfer_s: (d2h_ms + h2d_ms + prefetch_h2d_ms) / 1000; cumulative measured operation time, not wall-clock session latency or critical-path delay.
accounting.recomputation_time_s: Not instrumented in these archived runs. Token counts and scheduler CPU time do not provide an isolated recomputation duration.

limitations: CUDA-event operation sums can overlap model execution and do not measure all CPU management overhead.
No direct time comparison with prefix recomputation is possible from these timers.
One observation per load; restoration adds 36 GiB nominal host KV payload to the 24 GiB GPU KV pool.
These results concern host DRAM; no SSD or filesystem operations were measured.
